grok.performance_metric: public stake fully absorbed ~3y post-close; reporting terminated
grok.rationale: The FY2020 10-K attributes the swing to a $(711.5)M net loss and quarterly continuing-operations losses solely to COVID-19-driven retailer bankruptcies, store closures, and rent/occupancy pressure on the mall portfolio, with no documented inability to align any acquired product with operating processes (p4=0). Director resignations on July 30, 2021 are expressly stated as not due to disagreement, and no operations-vs-organization or cultural fracture is recorded before the July 2021 absorption and Form 15 termination (p5=0).
